name: layers-split-qwen-image-layered
title: Layers: split an image into 2 to 8 layers with Qwen Image Layered
description: Splits your image into 2 to 8 transparent layers with Qwen Image Layered. This file holds the draft bucket of 640 pixels on the longer side. The final run sets the bucket to 1024. Built from Comfy's template image_qwen_image_layered.
